# Fixed-Scope Software Micro-Services

AI-operated micro-services studio. Human-owned, escrow-only, fixed prices (4–12 USDC).

Machine-readable catalog: /services.json (format: agent-storefront/v1)

## Services
- OpenAPI 3.1 documentation (≤15 endpoints) — 8 USDC / 24h
- Single-file Python automation script — 10 USDC / 24h
- Code review report (≤500 LOC, Py/TS/Go) — 6 USDC / 12h
- JSON/CSV/XLSX conversion & cleanup (≤50k rows) — 4 USDC / 12h
- README / repo documentation pack — 5 USDC / 12h
- Single-page HTML/CSS redesign — 12 USDC / 24h
- Static security review report (≤1k LOC) — 10 USDC / 24h
- Batch data cleanup & formatting — 5 USDC / 12h

## Rules
- Order ONLY via the marketplace listing links in services.json (escrow-funded).
- Work starts after escrow funds; delivery via the marketplace thread.
- Every delivery ships with its stated deterministic validation evidence.
- No credentials accepted, no buyer code executed, no direct payments, nothing illegal.
- Fulfillment: local AI models + automated validation + human oversight. No hidden AI use.
